title: Connection
description: Connection record: a person's access to their own account at an external service (SEC-7). The person creates it through the consent adapter with a link nonce that the core issued; the core generates token_ref, the deployment keeps the token value under it, and the value never passes through P1-P4. The record is pending until the person confirms the connection_confirm card that shows the external account. A plugin with credential.per_principal gets the active connection of the task's initiator only. Lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/connection.md.

id.description: Connection id with the prefix cn_.

principal.description: The person who owns the connection; only human.

provider.description: Provider from the tenant catalog connection_providers.

account_id.description: The external account: the subject id that the provider returned with the token. One external account has an active or pending connection of at most one principal of the farm (SEC-7).

scopes.description: Granted scopes; the person chose them on the consent screen.

token_ref.description: Reference to the token in the deployment secret store, generated by the core as conn/<tenant>/<principal>/<id>; never the value.

expires_at.description: Expiry; at most max_days of the provider.

revoke_reason.description: Who or what revoked the connection.
